description: This Java source file defines the DeleteThingDefinitionStrategy class, which handles delete commands for Thing definitions within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It extends an abstract strategy class and implements logic to process delete commands, generate appropriate results, and manage entity tags.

classes.name: DeleteThingDefinitionStrategy
classes.description: A final class that extends AbstractThingCommandStrategy to specifically handle DeleteThingDefinition commands within the Ditto framework. It provides logic for processing delete requests for Thing definitions, including extracting definitions, generating delete events, and handling entity tags.

methods.name: doApply
methods.description: Overrides the doApply method to process a delete ThingDefinition command. It extracts the ThingDefinition from the given Thing and constructs a result, either a success with a delete event or an error if the definition is inaccessible.

methods.name: extractDefinition
methods.description: Helper method that retrieves the ThingDefinition from a given Thing, returning an Optional.

methods.name: getDeleteDefinitionResult
methods.description: Constructs a successful result for the delete operation, creating a delete event and response, including handling the ETag headers.

methods.name: previousEntityTag
methods.description: Returns the EntityTag representing the previous state of the Thing Definition, if available, for concurrency control.

methods.name: nextEntityTag
methods.description: Returns an empty Optional indicating no specific next EntityTag after deletion.
